metadata.title: Exotic $\mathbb{R}^4$'s as unions of two thickened circles
metadata.abstract: We give an infinite family of non-diffeomorphic exotic $\mathbb{R}^4$'s, each of which is the union of two copies of a standard open tubular neighborhood of the circle, which intersect in a standard open tubular neighborhood of the wedge of two circles. This gives the simplest known decomposition of an exotic $\mathbb{R}^4$ into two open sets, making progress on Question 4.43 (A) of Kirby's 1995 problem list. The decompositions are obtained by studying fibered slice disk complements in certain Casson-Gordon homotopy 4-balls, for which we provide similar decompositions. We distinguish the $\mathbb{R}^4$'s using end Floer homology.
metadata.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, No AI. Comments welcome!

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 构造无限多个互不微分同胚的 exotic R4，每个均由两个标准圆的开管状邻域之副本组成，交集为两个圆楔和的标准开管状邻域；利用 Casson–Gordon 同伦四球中的纤维化 slice disk 补空间构造，并以 end Floer 同调区分。
analysis.breakthrough: 在 Kirby 问题表的相关分解问题上给出极简的开集分解模型。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。摘要称为最简单的已知分解，尚非全部 exotic R4 的统一分类；评论中的 No AI 是作者否定声明，仍需独立全文核查。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 按与几何研究的关联、结论范围和可迁移方法安排阅读；摘要称为最简单的已知分解，尚非全部 exotic R4 的统一分类；评论中的 No AI 是作者否定声明，仍需独立全文核查。
